The '''Holy Order of the Je'ulajists''' was a religious organization founded by [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Michael Tandre]] after his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Alpha Kentrum]]'', crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orellon II]]. After making contact with the planet's indigenous people, the [[Kentra]], he became their spiritual leader, teaching the principles of [[Sword, Plow, and Spirit]]. Establishing the [[Temple of the Je'ulajists]], he even created a series of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programs which carried on his teachings long after his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TP" />

The Order remained active after Tandre's death, his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], although completely drained of power, was kept as a holy relic, called the "[[Sword of Honor]]." The Kentra named the order after Tandre, using a corrupted pronunciation of "geologists" in his honor.<ref name="TP" />
